items.text: What is the correct meaning of the Korean greeting '안녕하세요'?
items.expected: '안녕하세요' means 'Hello' or 'Hi' in English. It is a polite way to greet someone in Korean.

items.text: What is the Korean word for the number 'one'?
items.expected: The Korean word for 'one' is '하나'. It is used in native Korean counting.

items.text: Which particle is used to indicate the subject in the sentence: '저는 학생입니다'?
items.expected: The particle '는' is used to mark the subject here. '저는 학생입니다' means 'I am a student.' This particle emphasizes the subject of the sentence.
